name: Code
description: Git hosting whose durable state lives in object storage.

CODE_S3_BUCKET.description: Name of the object-store bucket that holds Code's write-ahead log.

CODE_S3_ENDPOINT.description: HTTPS endpoint for the S3-compatible object store.

CODE_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Access key for the object store.

CODE_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Secret access key for the object store.

CODE_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for Code's private administration endpoint.
